title: Create Assets Request
description: Multipart form for uploading one or more assets. Every asset is stored under a generated uuid, so uploads never overwrite each other.

file.description: Single uploaded file (multipart/form-data) - for single file upload

files.description: Array of uploaded files (multipart/form-data) - for multiple file upload

name.description: Label admins find the asset by (single upload); default the uploaded file name. The file name itself is the uuid.

alt.description: Default alt text; a section's own alt field overrides it

group_ids.description: Comma-separated ids of the groups that may view the asset(s). Omitted or empty = PUBLIC (everyone, including visitors who are not logged in).

role_ids.description: Comma-separated ids of the roles that may manage the asset(s) in the CMS. Omitted = the uploader's roles.

examples.alt: The research team in front of the institute
